default/32565.htm.text: Master Felix: From here you can take an airship to Gracia. We don't expect any trouble, but the magister and I are here to ensure order. However, I still feel uneasy. How can I sing songs knowing that many of our passengers are traveling to the land of their death? And if we can't contain the evil …
